caption: The Search page
preconditions: Seeded newsroom (tools/screenshots/SEED.md) so the results list shows Meridian News Service items
User preference search:filters_panel_open is at its default (true), so the advanced search panel is open
Search view is List View (not Photo Grid View)
steps: wait for [data-test-id="repo--ingest"] to be visible (the advanced search panel is open by default)
click #parameters-tab so the Parameters tab is active
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: Replaces image60, image73, image148 and the inline base64 Search and Advanced Search icons. Badges 1 to 5 follow the order of the header list on the page: Toggle filters, source dropdown, search box, total and sort, view switcher. Template: scripts/apps/search/views/search.html. The evaluate step moves the Search page down by 40 px so the badges sit in an empty band above each header control (badgeAnchor above); at the controls' corners they straddled the top bar and badge 2 looked as if it belonged to the filter button.

caption: Search terms highlighted in the results
preconditions: Seeded newsroom: several items mention 'election' (ELECTION-* sluglines, 'Coalition unveils election budget with tax cuts for families', 'Bond yields edge higher as investors weigh election risk')
features.elasticHighlight is true (the default host build sets it; the e2e client does not, so it is passed through appConfig)
steps: wait for [data-test-id="repo--ingest"] to be visible, then click .filter-trigger to close the advanced search panel
move the mouse away from the list so no row is hovered
notes: New shot. Highlights are <span class="es-highlight"> elements merged into headline/slugline by SearchService.mergeHighlightFields. The appConfig features block is the e2e client's features plus elasticHighlight, because TEST_APP_CONFIG replaces whole top-level blocks. The search tag 'election' must be visible above the list.

caption: The Filters tab
preconditions: Seeded newsroom so the aggregations have Content types, Desks, Category, Urgency and Priority values
steps: wait for [data-test-id="repo--ingest"] to be visible (the advanced search panel is open by default)
move the mouse away from the panel
notes: Replaces image67 and image87. The panel is a side panel, so a portrait crop is fine. Template: scripts/apps/search/views/search-filters.html. #advanced_search_filters is only the tab row; the filter list is in the .archive-sidebar column, which is the crop.

caption: Saving a search
preconditions: Admin has the saved_searches privilege (admin has all privileges)
steps: wait for [data-test-id="repo--ingest"] to be visible (the advanced search panel is open by default)
fill #search_description with 'Every item that mentions the election'
move the mouse away from the panel
notes: Replaces s-searchfilters.png. Do NOT click Ok (#search_save): the shot must not create a saved search. The 'Search shortcut' switch only appears when Make global is on and features.searchShortcut is set, so it is not in this shot. Template: scripts/apps/search/views/save-search.html and save-search-dialog.html.

caption: The Saved tab
preconditions: Done by seed.py: Saved search 'Election coverage' (private, owned by admin): POST /api/saved_searches as admin with {"name": "Election coverage", "description": "Every item that mentions the election", "is_global": false, "filter": {"query": {"q": "election", "repo": "archive,published"}}}

Done by seed.py: Saved search 'Sports results' (global, owned by admin): same call with {"name": "Sports results", "description": "Published sport from the last 24 hours", "is_global": true, "filter": {"query": {"q": "sport", "repo": "published"}}}

Done by seed.py: Saved search 'Budget watch' (global, owned by marenholt): POST /api/saved_searches logged in as marenholt with {"name": "Budget watch", "description": "Budget and tax stories", "is_global": true, "filter": {"query": {"q": "budget", "repo": "archive,published"}}}

Done by seed.py: Admin is subscribed to 'Sports results' so one 'Subscribed' label shows: PATCH it with {"subscribers": {"user_subscriptions": [{"user": "<admin id>", "scheduling": "0 8 * * *"}], "desk_subscriptions": []}}, or subscribe through the UI before the shot
steps: wait for [data-test-id="repo--ingest"] to be visible (the advanced search panel is open by default)
wait for .saved-searches to show 'My Saved Searches'
notes: New shot. 'My Saved Searches' lists the admin's own searches ('Sports results' marked [Global]); 'Global Saved Searches' lists other users' global searches with 'by Maren Holt'. Template: scripts/apps/search/views/saved-searches.html. Remove the three saved searches after capture, or restore the snapshot. The saved searches list is not inside #advanced_search_filters (that is only the tab row), so the crop is the .archive-sidebar column. The Subscribe link only shows while the pointer is over a saved search, so the last step hovers 'Election coverage'.

caption: Subscribing to a saved search
preconditions: Done by seed.py: Saved search 'Election coverage' exists for admin, with no subscription (see the saved-searches entry)
steps: wait for [data-test-id="repo--ingest"] to be visible (the advanced search panel is open by default)
wait for the modal heading 'New subscription' to be visible
move the mouse away from the modal
notes: New shot. Do NOT click Subscribe in the modal footer. Close with Cancel afterwards. Template: scripts/apps/search/views/saved-search-subscribe.html and edit-time-interval.html.
